This raises high suspicion for a lymphoproliferative disorder (e.g., lymphoma), particularly involving abdominal lymph nodes or organs (e.g., splenomegaly, hepatomegaly, retroperitoneal nodes) causing mass effect and constitutional symptoms. Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
